entry.title: Minishoot Adventures v0.6.0
entry.content:
## [0.6.0] - 2026-09-05
### Added
- A new setting called "Split Surf" has been added. - When enabled, each water type requires its own Surf item to be navigable. - When disabled, the normal Surf item unlocks navigation on all water types. - Will replace Surf and 4 filler items. - Water types are: Normal, Blue, Soiled, Dungeon and Gold. - Logic has been adjusted to accomodate this new setting. - Each surf items will be visible in the inventory. - A new setting called "Split Supershot" has been added. - When enabled, the Supershot is broken down into 2 distinct items. - Blastshot allows you to break rocks and walls. - Flameshot allows you to light torches. - Having one these two items will unlock Supershot for combat usage. - When enabled, Supershot and one filler item will be replaced. - Logic has been adjusted to accomodate this new setting. - Both of these items will be visible in the inventory. - A new setting called "Primordial Crystal Activation Threshold" has been added. - Set the Primordial Crystal activation threshold. - If your current HP percentage is greater than or equal to this value and you have the Primordial Crystal, it will activate. - This allows for more flexibility in the use of the Primordial Crystal, especially in combination with the "Enable Primordial Crystal Logic" option. - This option does not affect logic. The value must be between 10 and 100. - A new setting called "Progressive Boost" has been added. - When enabled, the game will fuse the Boost and the Advanced Energy module into two cumulative progressive upgrades. - The first upgrade will always allow you to boost, and the second will reduce the energy cost of boosting. - Note that both instances of Progressive Boost are marked as "Progression", although the second upgrade does not unlock any location. - A new setting called "Progressive Powers" has been added. - When enabled, the game will fuse all powers and the corresponding idols into two cumulative progressive upgrades. - The first upgrade will always allow you to use the corresponding power, and the second will grant you the idol's effect. - Note that both instances of Progressive Power of protection are marked as "Progression", although the second upgrade does not unlock any location. - The APWorld now has a manifest.
### Changed
- **IMPORTANT** Some settings and location names have been renamed. See [docs/dev/history/0-6-0-renames.md](docs/dev/history/0-6-0-renames.md) for the full list. - This means that you must change your YAML settings file for Archipelago. Refer to the file above for the replacements. - Fixed "Dungeon 3 - Behind North West doors" logic : now properly check for a way to use springboards - Necessary to unlock the door to said location. - All shop locations requiring Super Crystals are now locked behind the same conditions as clearing Dungeon 5. - As of now, there is no guarantee to have a sufficient amount of Super Crystals to buy the items you need. - This is temporary, as work on this very subject will begin soon-ish. - When the goal is set to "Spirit Tower", the Golden Crystal Heart will now replace a filler item, instead of an Ancient Tablet.
### Known issues
- Rarely, when hovering between a piece of land and a piece of water, Minishoot can fall.

entry.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong v0.4.5r2
entry.content:
Oops, so much for "one week break" but I felt very guilty over the state of 0.4.4 so I cut it a bit shorter. This is (despite the amount) a relatively half-baked update since not much was done for logic. The mappers are still working and I only have so much time to commit for it, especially with an event starting up in 11 hours. (Also obligatory this is for fun/free but if you wanna [buy me a coffee](https://streamlabs.com/batatvideogames/tip) I'd smile)
# Changelog
**General** - **Greatly overhauled Abyss story progression** - Lace Tower and Unravelled Silk Heart memories are skipped - There's also an additional YAML option to have faster (seamless) Silkheart pickup, defaulting to off - Needle upgrades and Pale Oils now have independent vanilla / anywhere options - Mottled Skarr: Curveclaw and Fractured Mask now remain collectible as AP checks after the merchant dies. Receiving either tool elsewhere no longer hides its unchecked location - Fixed Naked Trap persisting during deaths, memory fights, saves and resets - Reconnects now serialize connection attempts, discard stale-session callbacks and detach old callbacks - Save rollback now restores received items (it already did before but not as thoroughly as it should've) - Fixed reconnects unnecessary save hitch - Removed Hunter’s March - Rosary Chest and Far Fields - Rosary Chest 2 - get_logical_path & explain properly work with UT now (sorry :D) - Grand Mother Silks title card included in alphabet mode - Starting-crest slots remain in the pool even when that crest’s vanilla source is beyond the selected act goal - Fixed infinite jump/wall-slide exploit without Cling Grip - Cursed Crest bench restoration now refreshes both the spool and crest HUD, but never interferes with the real story curse - Alphabet/Spelling Bee generation now checks placement capacity and fails clearly instead of producing impossible fills - Vog hints now use Cogwork Core, High Halls, Memorium or Whispering Vaults instead of the vague Outlying Citadel label - Closed the abortion clinic on cursed ending wincon (no more self-softlocking allowed) - Inventory looked fucky while naked trap is happening - Bone Bottom/restored Bellhart: the title card no longer blocks benches or NPC interaction - Beastling Call disabled during Act 3 intro - No sending deathlink for dying during memory fights - Earlier Silkheart on ability rando to lessen reports over players not knowing that Needolin / Silksoar / Clawline require silk and also to put soar/line into logic earlier since not having silk could lead to softlocks - No more free dashing during specific frames when only owning one half of split swift step (by Skai) - Flea Brew refreshes by sitting on benches (by Skai) - Multibinder purchase mistakenly excluded from Act 1 - Fixed several things being in act 1/act 2/cursed ending when they shouldn't - After Widow defeat incoming DeathLinks now remain queued until Widow’s shrine completion finishes, then activate somewhere safe - Bilewater East Memory Locket now identifies the moving hanging-sack pickup by its exact hierarchy - Crest-slot hints now refresh immediately when scouting finishes instead of appearing blank on the first hover - F4 and recovery warps are blocked while Abyss Escape is active, preventing the escape sequence from being skipped and story progression from desynchronizing - Fixed Trobbio’s regular and Tormented Claw Mirror checks not triggering from the proper victory reward states - Objective Open: Grand Gate properly shows AP-owned bell amount and which ones - Bells from bellshrine-sanity cannot be put into Act 3 (sorry I forgot the fleas need to pass through Judge arena) - Receiving the Curvesickle upgrade while Curveclaw is equipped now updates the tool immediately instead of temporarily disabling it until a room change - Grouped together Far Fields Shell Shard Caches 2-3 and Rosary Cache 18 as one map marker, same with Shell Shard Cache 4-5 - The Blasted Steps entrance sign from Shellwood and the Terminus Commandment are now randomized lore locations - The nonexistent Memorium Bone Plaque and Clover Plaque locations have been removed - Better Bell/Melody tracking if the YAML option to show them on map is on - Shakra doesn't leave (no need for additional mods) in fact uninstall ShakraAlwaysOnSite, that mod messed with flags (bad) - Loose Beast Shard checks dropped by enemies are restored after death or a room reload if they weren’t collected - Alchemist’s Assistant now removes the consumed Needle Phial - Silk and Soul now recognizes an AP-owned Snare Setter - Balm for the Wounded should now suppress the original animation and hand over checks no problem - The second Progressive Claw Mirror properly replaces the first across every crest instead of allowing both mirrors to be equipped - Drifter’s Cloak now works after Faydown with only one Progressive Swift Step, the physical Cloak pickup is no longer needed - Open Grand Gate now appears whenever Act 2 begins, regardless of how the player enters Act 2 - Wreath of Purity now spends one of its three charges when blocking a Muckmaggot trap. Once exhausted, the trap applies normally - Did I ever even mention that Wreath of Purity can block these traps since 0.4.0 ? Pretty nifty right ? - F4/recovery warps now fail active courier deliveries through the game’s delivery-breaking behavior - Collecting the randomized Shellwood Mask Shard didn't fire its original event, causing the intended Phacia ambush to not spawn - Opened Silkeaters will respawn if player leaves the room or dies without picking it up and only disappear once they're obtained - Locations sent via /send_location will now disappear as map marker immediately rather than on reboot - item_link had a funky interaction if only one player had alphabet mode on
**Logic** * **Added most of Bilewater in logic** * **Overhauled Putrified Ducts logic** * Left side Greymoor is still (officially) unmapped but it got some temporary logic to hopefully help the worse parts of it that players can get stuck on * Blasted Steps Bellway no longer places Sister Splinter in No Skips logic. Its enemy-pogo route requires Easy Skips * Forge Daughter’s four checks are mapped and no longer LogicUnknown * Only Shellwood - Weaver Harp Inscription requires Needolin in Shellwood_10, not the Pollip Heart or Cling Grip in that map part * First Sinner’s logical path now clearly says to collect the fixed vanilla Heretic Key * Silkshot (Original) reconciles an AP-received Ruined Tool at the repair desk * Restored Queen’s Egg progression logic using Bellhart, Missing Brother, courier delivery and the precise Styx-room * Fixed Rite of Rebirth and follow up quest logic * Fixed Silk and Soul wish being bugged (still needs a major rework though) * Shellwood Mask Shard: removed the "ledge grab alone" route. Sprint alone no longer reaches it due to player expectations * Architect's Melody no longer in logic from just Clawline * Huge Flea can no longer hold required progression until its exact movement requirement is known * Last Judge and everything beyond the arena now require the exact arena-completion event, rather than becoming available from Blasted Steps Bellway access alone * Logic now accounts for Grand Bellway as way to enter citadel/act 2 proper (act 1 goals excluded) * Pimpillo can no longer hold required progression while left-side Greymoor remains unmapped * Far Fields Shell Shard Cache 8 is restricted to filler/useful items because it can become permanently inaccessible * Far Fields Rosary Caches 3 and 4 now correctly require Drifter’s Cloak and Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that option is enabled) * The Skull Cave Mask Shard and shard cache no longer appear in logic without Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that option is enabled) * Entering the Deep Docks mines from Far Fields with Clawline, Silk Soar and one Silk Heart now correctly puts Flintslate, Shard Bundle 1, Forebrothers and the areas beyond them in logic * Broodfeast now recognizes the appropriate AP-owned tools for all three organ types * Greymoor’s Silkeater is now LogicUnknown until western Greymoor is mapped * Great Taste of Pharloom and its Pale Oil reward now require the Last Judge to be defeated (edit: I never considered that the Phantom route is even a possibility. I am part of the problem) * Adjusted Memorium Spool Fragment and Deep Docks Flea (Mines) logic adjusted to need Cling Grip (or Scuttlebrace if that setting is enabled) * Cogwork Core - Pristine Core now has proper Act 3 requirement for logic

entry.title: Civilization IV v0.0.1r3
entry.content:
Thanks to Konzera taking the plunge to run this in an actual multiworld, I've fixed a couple of important bugs. You need both the new APWorld and mod for these changes. Check the previous release for more details on Wondersanity and other big changes from 0.2.
### Changelog: - Changed some backend behavior so large lists of items are actually sent to the game. - Fixed a typo preventing the Mausoleum of Maussollos check from being sent
### Installation Instructions: 1. Unzip Civ4-Archipelago-Mod into your Beyond the Sword mod folder (I've been testing it in the My Games one, but theoretically it should also work in the installation folder one; let me know if one or both work or don't work!), make sure the structure is Beyond the Sword/Mods/Civ4-Archipelago-Mod and that there isn't an extra folder in that structure. 2. Install the APWorld as normal.
### Play Instructions: 1. Run the Civilization IV client from Archipelago, but **do not connect from the client**; you'll do so in-game (and eventually I want to remove the ability to connect from the client) 2. Start a new Civ4 Beyond the Sword game as normal--**I highly recommend playing in windowed mode**, since this is an alpha and if the game freezes it can be difficult/impossible to close out of it if it's in full screen mode. 3. When you load in you'll get a popup saying to connect to the Archipelago Server: you do this by opening up the BUG options (the little dragon in the upper-right corner), entering in your information, then clicking "Save and Connect." If the connection is successful you'll get a popup that says "Successfully Connected," and you can play as normal. If you get an error, try connecting again, it most often means you don't have the client open or you're already connected in the client. Occasionally however the connection will be slow and you connect in the client but get an error in-game; in that case disconnect in the client and try again. **If this happens a lot to you let me know!**
### Gameplay Issues: 1. You can still receive techs in Techsanity from some ways that aren't traditional research: starting techs from your leader and tech trading, and this could lead to duplicates. These are planned to be removed in future updates. Let me know if things break because of them--they shouldn't, but I'm not 100% certain. 2. The settings aren't balanced at all, and it may make you do things like get 9 Great Scientists when all you have is the library or research Satellites before you have any economic techs. The Techsanity Era Gates setting should help the latter, and I'd highly recommend against large GPsanity numbers unless you have a lot of time to kill (though the added Great People in the pool will help). 3. There are a lot of debugging messages left in the mod. I removed some of them, but don't expect a clean feed. 4. When you're trying to select an "obsolete" wonder to build in the city screen, the building options will jump to the top of the building list due to the hacky way I've implemented that ability. I want to fix it eventually, but for now the easiest way to mitigate it is to use the wonder filter on the right side of the city list (the star), which will have it jump back to the start of the wonders, which hopefully won't make it jump. You can also use the "choose what to build next" dialog, or just select it without moving your mouse (use the scroll wheel).
### Technical Issues: 1. I had generation errors when creating solo/near-solo multiworlds with high Techsanity Era Gates values--I never tested with higher values with locations other than Techsanity enabled but keep that in mind if you're having trouble generating. 2. Whenever you close and reopen the game/a save file, you need to disconnect the client, and you should close and reopen the client to avoid missing checks. I plan to try and automate this in future updates. 3. There have been bug reports of items received/obtained while offline not properly appearing in-game and/or being sent to the multiworld when reconnecting. I think this is related to mismatching either mod or APworld versions, but I haven't fully found the root cause yet.
If you have any questions, bug reports, or things I forgot to mention, let me know in [the Civilization IV thread in the Archipelago Discord server](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1326231506682904576).
Github for the APWorld: https://github.com/VincentBorchardt/Archipelago/blob/main/worlds/civ_4/

## Information This archipelago implementation is in **early development** and is in public pre-release for testing, so may not be complete and/or may contain bugs that heavily disrupt the experience. **Fix** * Fixed a missing rule for the `Item from Amanita` location when Striaton Gym is dark
**YAML Options List** * The following options need to be added to the Black and White YAML under `plugin_options`: ``` plugin_options: extra_logic: # same as v8 randomize_starting_town: true starting_town_blacklist: [] # list in README add_ss_ticket: true add_pass: true hm_with_badges: true add_rock_smash: true add_rock_smash_musharna: true # requires add_rock_smash extra_cut_trees: true extra_cut_trees_kyurem: true # requires extra_cut_trees move_strength_boulders: true move_strength_boulders_vi_road: true # requires move_strength_boulders dark_areas: ["Wellspring Cave B1F", "Mistralton Cave", "Challengers Cave"] # supports "_All" and "_Random", see README ```
